Hi team — quick triage from Platform Ops:
- We pulled the outgoing .ics for rdw-evt-7642. The ORGANIZER header was present and correct, but Exchange/Acme's outbound mail gateway appears to be rewriting the header during tunneling/SSO enforcement which causes some calendar clients to compute an unexpected checksum.
- Evidence: the sent .ics matches our stored copy; the copy delivered to Acme (we fetched via delivery trace) has an added X-Exchange-Auth field and a modified ORGANIZER URI (mailto:organizer+acme-rewrite@acmeinc.com).

Short-term remediation (implemented now):
1) Ben has created a Zoom meeting (link below) and I generated a Zoom-compatible .ics with a static organizer and passcode. Attached: zoom-temp-invite.ics
2) We're sending a refreshed invite to Tom + Acme IT and removing the original Meet link from the body to avoid confusion.
3) Ops will continue to investigate gateway rewrite patterns and flag if this affects other enterprise customers.

Zoom join link (temp): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=TEMP_PASSCODE
